## What changes / 改动

Describe the mentor/source/principle or code behavior being added or corrected.
说明新增或纠正的人物、来源、原则或代码行为。

## Evidence and review scope / 证据与核对范围

For content changes, link the original sources and specific locators. State who reviewed what, any AI assistance, and what remains pending. Keep full source material and local review state out of the PR.
内容改动请附原始来源与定位，说明谁核对了什么、AI 辅助情况及待核部分。不要提交全文素材或本机复核状态。

## Validation / 验证

Report relevant `validate`, `doctor --mcp`, and test results, plus any affected scenario or catalog updates. Content review is separate from passing automated checks.
说明相关校验、自检、测试结果与场景／目录更新；自动检查通过不代表内容已核验。
